match: 決済ベンダーの認証が遅れているので

items.statement: Move the payments launch to 15 November
items.quote: 決済ベンダーの認証が遅れているので、リリースは11月15日に延期しましょう。
items.translation: Because the payments vendor’s certification is delayed, let’s postpone the release to 15 November.
items.task_title: Update the release checklist for 15 Nov

items.statement: Send the staging data to Dewi by Monday
items.quote: Aiko-san, tolong kirim data staging sebelum hari Senin, ya.
items.translation: Aiko, please send the staging data before Monday.
items.task_title: Send the staging data to Dewi

items.statement: Update the retry policy document by Friday
items.quote: Aiko-san、リトライのポリシー文書を金曜日までにお願いします。
items.translation: Aiko, please update the retry policy document by Friday.

items.statement: Request a second sandbox account from the vendor
items.quote: We will request a second sandbox account from the vendor this week.
